last_analysis: I can't see any scores, so I'm choosing on design reasoning, not on evidence. All 9 trials trained without errors. Three lines have been tried: recipes that give more samples (2 epochs, then 1 epoch with lr 0.002, up to about 405k steps), a per-layer landing head that matches the drop rule, and wider context (a deeper trunk with a global broadcast, or cell self-attention). Each run uses 2 seeds, and the final pick is the best 2-seed score, so in this last round I'll combine the parts that are most likely to be strong rather than repeat a trial. I'll add the 1-epoch, data-rich recipe to the per-layer head, which has been tried with 4 and 2 epochs but not 1. I'll put the per-layer head on the attention trunk, so the head handles landing and attention handles ordering. I'll run the attention trunk with the 1-epoch recipe. All three stay under about 1.5x compute and use only 2D operations, so they should finish well inside the time limit.
